decisions.reason: The exact Bézier-path rule applies specifically to deriving the É accent. The closing V retains its existing derivation and right-arm-reach requirements unchanged.

Literal derivation of the É accent does not change the E and L construction values. The separate same-message decision to resume full-wordmark development is already represented by the existing RESUME Event.
The Hero V supplies the terminal geometry, but the decision changes how that geometry is duplicated for the É accent; it does not alter the approved Hero V itself.
The É accent's vector-path correspondence does not change the wordmark's kerning or rhythm requirements. The separate same-message resumption of spacing work is already represented.
The accent geometry decision does not alter the requirement to provide short design rationales with review rounds.
The literal É accent construction rule does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment or its application constraint.
Reference to exact Bézier curves concerns the accent's design construction, not the final production-ready asset handoff standard.
The accent derivation decision has no effect on accepted review-image formats or preview-file accessibility.
